parts.name: Handle
parts.Basic_description: This is the handle of the bucket, made of durable plastic, typically cylindrical or curved for easy gripping.
parts.Functional_description: The handle allows the user to lift and carry the bucket comfortably, distributing the weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It can rotate or pivot slightly around its attachment points to facilitate carrying and pouring.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the bucket, made of molded plastic with a rectangular shape and vented sides.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as the primary container for holding liquids or solid materials.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and rigid, providing structural support for the handle and contents.
